Compress or irritation of ≥1 cervical n. roots → pain · sensory disturb · motor weakness
Eti: degen dz (cervical spondylosis · disc herniation) MC - foraminal stenosis · facet osteophytes · trauma · tumors · abscess
Roots exit above their corresponding vertebral body (ex, C7 root exits b/n C6 & C7)
Posterolat disc herniation MC anatomic cause - USU C5-C6 & C6-C7
Pain · sensory sxs · weakness in neck · shoulder · arm or hand (by root) - ± axial neck pain · occipital HA (upper cervical)
C5: deltoid · biceps → shoulder pain · ↓biceps reflex
C6: pain to lat forearm & thumb · ↓biceps & brachioradialis reflexes
C7: neck → posterior arm & forearm → dorsal hand & 3rd digit · medial scapular pain - weak forearm extension & pronation (triceps · wrist flexors) - ↓/absent triceps reflex (hallmark)
C8: medial forearm & 4th-5th digits - weak finger flexion & grip
PE: Spurling maneuver · shoulder abduction relief test · sensory mapping · myotomal strength · DTRs
MRI = modality of choice - CT/MRI for red flags or severe dz (neuro deficit)
